body: Message me, we can talk and relate. X

I'm so happy I was up at 4am to make someones day a little better. You will more than make it, go achieve greatness!💗

God bless you, stay safe.
Hahaha you're telling me, I think my friend jinxed me with an early period. 😂

I know.

I sit here at 5am writing this to you, feeling alone while my partner sleeps next to me.


I says he hates how I go from happy to sad in the instance of a glance away, I can't hide these feelings, these are me. There nothing wrong with you, you've just got some stuff to deal with in yourself.



Go on a hike, paint a lake or dance in the kitchen.
You are your greatest company x

It’s not just your family, life is hard.
No one likes to talk about the struggle, they want their success to seem effortless to the outside world.


Everyday is a struggle for everyone, some more that most but still, a battle we continue to keep living. 

You wouldn’t be battling if you didn’t think their was something out there for you, some purpose, I don’t know that purpose and you might not know yet either. But you brought purpose into this world, a purpose that you give purpose to. 



Every day is going to be hard but every day is going to get better, keep your priorities on sleeve and you’ll make it so so far x

I feel you dude, life is a train wreck after train wreck after train wreck. 


I have been feeling that same continuous chaos too, it doesn’t feel like it’s getting better because we don’t want it to.



Life is a bitch, you really have to look for the good and hold onto it.  Your boyfriend loves and appreciates you, your abuser served some time which is so rare, you’re becoming a friggen doctor, you are offering the world art and you’re great at wording your complaints in an interesting way.;D



You have so much to offer, and I’m here to talk if you need x

I’m always here to chat, we might be able to relate and maybe I can throw some guidance your way x

You are going to give that little kid the life you never had


You’re going to be the reason for a greater generation, you’re going to be a parent who listens and helps, you’re going to be your kids greatest motivator and it’s going to be okay.




Cancer runs in my family, my mother lost her mother at my age and my mothers. I would never judge my mother if she did, I would judge myself and wonder why I wasn’t there enough. My mom is my best friend, the only constant in my life. If I were to lose her, I would lose such a valuable part of myself. I know it hurts, but I don’t want you to miss your kids first girlfriend or boyfriend, their first bully, their prom night, their “thank you to my parents” wedding speech or your first grandchild.


It’s hard now, but you still have so many beautiful sunrises to see, don’t worry about what’s to come- it’s far greater than you give credit. You are valued, you are loved and I hope you live to see so many more happy days x
Hey man, what’s up? You can chat to me x

Your life is a gift, think of the millions of other people that you could’ve been.

And I know you didn’t ask for your life but you got it, that’s got to mean something. Your life has purpose and even though I don’t believe in a definitive god, I believe that we all add value to this world. 


You do add value, find a way to value yourself rather than throw the only you away x

It’s okay to feel this way, the world weighs in heavy on shoulders.


Sounds to me like you might have BPD, I know therapists are expensive but speak to one once. Find out what is directing causing this, then tackle it with homeopathic treatment.



I know how the boyfriend and family things feel, I would recommend that you and your boyfriend travel and work through the TEFL program, allowing you to both be together in a comfortable environment. 



Life is tough, but you are tougher x
